title: LFTF: Locating First and Then Fine-Tuning for Mitigating Gender Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the absolute difference in next-token probabilities for gendered pronouns ('he' and 'she') given prompts containing various professions (using the GenBiasEval dataset and AFGB-Score metric), and measuring the consistency of model responses when explicit gender hints are provided in the prompts (using the GenHintEval dataset and UB-Score metric).
